ns2:course.label: Luso-Brazilian Culture
ns2:course.description: Affords a broad understanding of Luso-Brazilian civilization and culture. 3 undergraduate hours. 2 or 4 graduate hours. May be repeated if topics vary. Prerequisite: PORT 320 or equivalent or consent of instructor.
